findings.claim: physical_delete now raises 409 for an ambiguous name inside purge_all_trash, whose single commit comes after the loop, so earlier files in the loop are already unlinked when the exception rolls the session back.
findings.impact: After Empty Trash meets one ambiguous entry, earlier trashed files are gone from disk but their rows stay in Trash. Every later Empty Trash hits the same entry again and returns 409 until the user purges that file by hand. Repeating the purge does clear the stale rows, so no data is lost beyond the files the user already trashed.
findings.evidence: backend/app/services/fileops.py:670 (existing_or_409 before unlink at 673), :756-759 (loop with one db.commit after it). purge_all_missing (:811-814) commits per batch, but missing rows have no on-disk match, so they are not ambiguous in practice.

bucket_proposal.reason: I12 requires 409 and no change for the ambiguous file itself; it does not define batch behaviour. The disk and DB are left out of step only for already-trashed files, and a repeat purge repairs it.

findings.proposed_fix: In purge_all_trash, resolve every file with existing_or_409 before unlinking any, or catch the 409 per file and skip it.
